kurz: Starch on the surface bonds to the pan before a firm crust can form.
bild_im_kopf: Like wallpaper paste: wet it sticks fast, only once dry does it let go.

ursachen.warum: In a lukewarm pan the starch [[staerkeverkleisterung|gelatinises]] into a sticky layer before it dries out.
fix: Preheat the pan well with fat
Add the potatoes only once the fat shimmers

ursachen.warum: A firm crust releases by itself. Before that, you tear it off.
fix: Shake the pan lightly to test

ursachen.titel: Raw potatoes with a starch film
ursachen.warum: Freshly cut raw potatoes bring a lot of loose starch.
fix: Use boiled potatoes from the day before

ursachen.warum: Without a film of fat, the pieces sit directly on the metal.
fix: Cover the base thinly but completely

q1.frage: Did the fat sizzle when the potatoes went in?

q2.frage: Did you turn them within the first few minutes?
